title: Grand Luxe on 30A
description_expanded: Home Highlights - New Construction - Gulf Views - Private Heated Pool w/ Observation Deck (Pool can be heated for an additional $50 per day from October 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 - 6 Bikes and 6 seater Golf Cart - Shuffleboard/Media Room - Elevator Welcome to your elevated escape in Seagrove Beach, Grand Luxe on 30A, where space, style, and location come together effortlessly. This expansive 6-bedroom home offers over 6,000 square feet to spread out, relax, and reconnect, all just steps from two nearby beach access points. With Gulf views woven throughout the property, every level invites you to soak in the beauty of the coast. One of the highlights is a rooftop pool paired with a fifth-floor observation deck that delivers unforgettable panoramic views of the Gulf. Whether you're starting your morning with coffee above the coastline or ending the day with sunset swims, this space was made for memorable moments. Inside, the home strikes the perfect balance between laid-back comfort and upscale design. Natural textures and warm tones carry throughout, from the unique blend of limestone and white oak flooring to the custom woodwork that adds character in all the right places. The open living areas feel both welcoming and refined, anchored by a cozy fireplace and thoughtfully designed gathering spaces. The kitchen and dining areas are equally impressive, featuring custom details and plenty of room to host meals, celebrations, or casual nights in. Each bedroom offers a private retreat, while the bathrooms bring a spa-like touch with beautiful finishes and calming design elements. Designed with groups and families in mind, the home also features a spacious game room and a bunk room that’s perfect for kids or extra guests. Every detail has been considered to make your stay as comfortable as it is memorable. Perfectly located along 30A, you’re just a short stroll or bike ride from Seagrove’s favorite dining spots, shops, and scenic coastal charm, making this home an ideal setting for your next beach getaway. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor - Bunkroom Twin over Twin + additional Twin w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Half Bathroom Second Floor - Master King Bedroom, w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate - King Bedroom, w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Third Floor - King Bedroom, w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Sleeper Sofa - Half Bathroom Fourth Floor - King Bedroom, w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only - Half Bathroom
